dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a high-degree curvature spline from the mid-base to the apex, indicating a highly falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, forming a sharp terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive slope approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the visible dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height-to-base width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped notch located on the posterior margin of the upper fluke segment; numerous small, white punctate epidermal marks scattered across the body.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of small white circular spots/speckling covering the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.
